The arable land borders with various features, including inland waters (~258,000 sqm), urban fabric (~91,000 sqm), broad-leaved forest (~78,000 sqm), and complex cultivation patterns (~72,000 sqm). Additionally, the inland waters are adjacent to the urban fabric. The landscape is characterized by a mix of agricultural areas, artificial surfaces, and water bodies, reflecting a diverse and multifaceted environment.
